# Overview

This neutral fixture describes a fictional process for organizing colored cards. It contains no personal, institutional, or research-project data. The example citation points to a fictional source [@example2026].

## Materials

The process uses three reusable materials:

- Blue cards for sorting
- A paper tray for collecting
- A printed guide for instructions
